'''Parsol d'Ahndole''' was a hero and adventurer who was active during the early days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The deeds performed by d'Ahndole were considered by many to be decidedly heroic in nature and were dramatized in a series of [[Holodrama/Legends|holofeatures]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operative named [[Graf Yonna]] developed an [[Multiple personality disorder|alternate personality]] modeled after d'Ahndole's romanticized persona and also took his name. In particular, this personality exhibited by Yonna was melodramatic, had an extreme intolerance toward those he perceived to be evil&mdash;which led him to kill an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|general]] whom he was assigned to merely kidnap&mdash;and drove him to perform heroic feats, which saved thousands of Rebel lives.
